title: Build TechBridge Homepage
description: Create the main TechBridge homepage using HTML and CSS. Focus on structure, branding, navigation and responsive design.

title: Build TechBridge Programs Experience
description: Create a professional Programs experience that presents the Data Analytics and Web Development programs offered by TechBridge.

title: Build Internship Tasks Experience
description: Create an interface that presents the internship tasks and helps interns understand the overall internship journey.

title: Build an Interactive Internship Roadmap
description: Use JavaScript to allow visitors to switch between the Data Analytics and Web Development internship tracks.

title: Build TechBridge Challenge Hub
description: Create a challenge hub where interns can explore practical challenges and test their technical skills.

title: Build Interactive Intern Dashboard
description: Create a dashboard where interns can view their progress, tasks, status and internship information.

title: Build Task Submission System
description: Create an interface through which interns can prepare and submit their task work.

title: Build Complete TechBridge Internship Platform
description: Combine the different components created throughout the internship into a complete TechBridge platform.
